title: Accounts Receivable
description:
Cashier Administrator

Location: Peterborough
Salary: Up to £27,000 per annum
Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (hybrid after 3/6 months)

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Cashier Administrator to join our busy finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous finance or cashiering experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in maintaining accuracy.

You will play a key role in ensuring financial transactions are processed efficiently, reconciliations are completed accurately, and finance records are maintained to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities
- Posting and allocating daily cash sheets and banking transactions.
- Processing journals where required.
- Handling finance-related queries and resolving issues promptly.
- Completing full bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Auditing cashbook supporting documentation to ensure completeness and authorisation.
- Maintaining accurate filing and record-keeping systems.
- Posting cash-paid transactions, including cheque payments and cleared banking entries.
- Supporting the wider finance team with administrative duties as required.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within a finance, accounts, cashiering or administrative role.
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- The ability to manage a high volume of transactions efficiently.
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Experience using accounting or finance systems would be advantageous but is not essential.

Benefits
- Competitive salary up to £27,000 depending on experience.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Contributory pension scheme.
- Life assurance.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- Career progression within a growing organisation.
- Employee discounts and benefits platform.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.

Please apply for this role and send your CV to . Interviews to be held on site this week.

title: HR Assistant
description:
VERO HR url removed is a rapidly growing HR outsourcing business based in Peterborough providing its UK wide and international client base with a full range of people services. Technology is key to how we engage with our clients, but our service delivery is based upon combining the benefits of tech with what we do best - the personal touch.

Who we are looking for:

With proven experience in a HR Administrator role and a friendly, approachable style you will have:
- Proven HR administrative skills.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to forge strong relationships.
- Strong organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.

- A "can do" approach.

If you have a passion for the delivery of high-quality service and the ability to work in a highly organised way, then we want to hear from you!

If you have the right attributes, skillset and feel you will be able to add value, then what are you waiting for hit that apply button to find out more

title: Insurance Customer Service Administrator
description:
Insurance Customer Service

Location : Peterborough

Salary : £25000

Essential : Must have insurance experience to apply

Insurance Customer Service Administrator

We are seeking a highly organised and professional Customer Service Administrator to join our clients team. This role involves providing exceptional customer support, managing administrative tasks, and ensuring smooth communication between clients and internal departments. The successful candidate will utilise their strong organisational skills and IT proficiency to contribute to the efficient operation of our customer service functions.

Responsibilities

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk

Department: Finance / Accounts

Location: Peterborough

Salary: £27,000

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable Clerk to join our finance team. This role is responsible for maintaining accurate purchase ledger records, ensuring invoices and payments are processed efficiently, and supporting the smooth operation of day-to-day finance activities.

The successful candidate will have strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain purchase ledger accounts and ensure records are accurate and up to date.
- Review ledgers regularly to minimise aged debt and resolve outstanding account queries.
- Download and allocate bank statements on a daily basis.
- Investigate and resolve cash allocation issues, obtaining remittances and supporting documentation where required.
- Process supplier invoices and credit notes accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Reconcile intercompany invoices and credits.
- Accurately code invoices and credit notes to the correct nominal ledger accounts.
- Complete monthly and ad hoc supplier statement reconciliations.
- Prepare and process payment runs in accordance with company procedures.
- Process ad hoc payment requests and employee expense claims, ensuring all approvals and supporting documentation are in place.
- Assist with month-end processes and reporting requirements.
- Liaise with colleagues and stakeholders to resolve invoice, payment, and account queries.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger, or Finance Assistant role.
- Accountancy graduates.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good understanding of accounting processes and financial controls.
- Competent in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines.
- Experience working with accounting or finance systems is desirable.

Personal Attributes
- Customer-focused approach.
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement solutions.
- Proactive and organised.
- Team player willing to support colleagues when required.
- Committed to continuous improvement and delivering high standards of work.

Please send your CV to or apply for this role, interviews to be held next week.

title: Purchasing Assistant
description:
Purchasing Assistant

Initially a 3 month contract with the possibility of moving into a maternity cover.

Hybrid Working Available

Are you looking to build a career in purchasing and procurement?

We are working with a well-established organisation that is looking to appoint a Junior Purchasing professional to join its procurement team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has either recently started their career in purchasing or has gained some initial exposure to procurement activity and is now looking to develop their skills further.

You don't need to have extensive purchasing experience. Perhaps you have been involved in raising purchase orders, obtaining quotations, communicating with suppliers or supporting an existing procurement team and are keen to take the next step.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers, you will help ensure goods and services are purchased efficiently, competitively and in line with business requirements.

What will you be doing
- Raising and processing purchase orders accurately.
- Requesting and comparing supplier quotations.
- Liaising with suppliers regarding orders, deliveries and queries.
- Supporting supplier research and purchasing decisions.
- Following up on outstanding orders and resolving issues.
- Maintaining accurate purchasing records and supporting internal stakeholders.

What are we looking for?

This role would suit someone who is early in their purchasing or procurement career and is keen to develop.

You may already have:
- Some experience within purchasing, procurement, buying or supply chain.
- Experience raising purchase orders or processing orders.
- Exposure to communicating with suppliers and requesting quotations.
- An understanding of basic purchasing processes.
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills.
- The confidence to communicate with both suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- A proactive approach and willingness to learn.

We would also consider candidates from a purchasing administration, sales administration, customer service or supply chain support background where there has been some exposure to suppliers, orders or purchasing activity.

A CIPS qualification or studying towards one would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The opportunity

This is a great opportunity to join an established procurement function and gain broader exposure to purchasing, supplier management, sourcing and procurement processes.

For the right person, the role offers the opportunity to develop commercially and professionally while building a long-term career within procurement.

If you have some initial purchasing experience and are looking for your next step, we'd be keen to hear from you.

You should make yourself aware of how immigration laws apply to your situation before applying for any jobs. We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this role.
